name: Finbar
long_description:
Finbar is high-quality financial data and intelligence, used by several of the world's largest hedge funds. It automates financial modelling, research, and data analysis so multi-million-dollar decisions can be made 100x faster.

Finbar maintains its own dataset of worldwide company filings, presentations, transcripts, and more, delivering clean data from these fundamental sources within minutes of release. This data is available via web, Excel add-in, API, and MCP. 

Our services include: company primers and prebuilt models; AI tools for analysts to create their own research; Excel tools to build financial models in minutes and update them in seconds; API streams to integrate our worldwide data into any programmatic or agentic system.

question_answers.question: How did your company get started? (i.e., How did the founders meet? How did you come up with the idea? How did you decide to be a founder?)
question_answers.answer: Edward & Robin have been friends for more than half their lives: King’s Scholars at Eton, undergrads at Oxford, roommates in London. Edward founded **finbar** in 2023 as a solution to the time-consuming ‘grunt’ work of his former hedge fund role, and wrote most of the MVP up to first revenue. Robin joined in 2024 to take the lead on software dev as CTO.

question_answers.question: What is the core problem you are solving? Why is this a big problem? What made you decide to work on it?
question_answers.answer: A huge amount of the financial industry still runs on manual data input: thousands of workers whose job is simply to copy data from documents, build historical time series, and update models by hand. We leverage cutting-edge tech to finally automate this process, delivering more data, faster, and with much lower cost overhead.

launches.title: Finbar: Financial intelligence for every investor
launches.tagline: Financial data and AI tools trusted by the world's largest hedge funds
launches.body:
**Finbar is financial data and intelligence for the AI age.**

We’re super excited to announce our first public launch. Give us a go if you’re interested in: worldwide company fundamental data (incl. via API/MCP), AI tools for data analysis and investment research, prebuilt models, an Excel add-in for building + updating custom models, and more.

**Get started at [https://finbar.com](https://finbar.com).** Read on if you're interested in how we're differentiated, and why some of the biggest investors in the world rely on us for their research processes.

<https://youtu.be/1jK1pUDtK3E>

**---**

Hi! Ed and Robin here, here to announce the first general availability of Finbar. **Our mission is to give every investor (and agent) the best data and tools to conduct high-quality financial research.**

_A brief recap of our journey_. We started with a single product - **reliably updating any financial model within 5 minutes of market release, without any mistakes**. Seems niche? It was - but it meant we could truly stand out to customers, solving a real burning problem that those who haven't worked in hedge funds just don't really 'get'. Over Q2 earnings season, we handled 150,000 model updates, meaning our clients (including several of the world's largest hedge funds) could go into every market-open with all of their models ready.

Developing this product turned out to be a problem that seemed simple but actually was fiendishly difficult (not least for the data reasons discussed below). Doing so, however, has meant building some truly unique financial data and infrastructure, which we've since deployed in many other products - and now available to all investors.

Two key parts to what we do:

**I. We're building the best fundamental financial dataset**

Underlying everything is our proprietary data. **We collect and ingest millions of documents across thousands of companies worldwide**: reports, presentations, transcripts. You might be surprised this is not a solved problem already. But almost all providers lack at least one of: a) breadth, b) quality, and/or c) speed. All three have been necessary to serve our clients, hence the need to build our own. And yes, we're including players like Factset, S&P and Bloomberg in this (we're often explicitly evaluated against them by our institutional clients).  

Some snippets to illustrate the point:

    1) _The most important fundamental datapoints are often not in 10Qs/10Ks, and rarely in a fully-structured format._ Think segment organic growth in presentation charts, conference call remarks on forward guidance, Pillar 3 banking disclosures, and a million other company-specific datapoints.

    2) _>1/2 of our customers invest outside of the US._ International markets have much less structured data availability than the US, often not even a central repository, and it is where arguably there is more edge from strong fundamental data (these two facts may well be corollary)

    3) _Financial data is exceptionally messy on the tail end_ - which is often also where the insights live. Understanding nuances around restatements, accounting regime changes, mergers and divestments, and all the other insane things companies do to produce messy data (sometimes on purpose) is bread-and-butter in our design. It causes many nights of hair-pulling but is the only way to actually produce great data that investors trust.

**II. We're building the best financial toolkit for the AI age**

Upon this data foundation is a whole range of Finbar products, built on the knowledge and experience of what professional investors actually need. This includes:

* Machine-readable versions of millions of worldwide company documents
* Fundamental time-series and datapoints on thousands of line items
* Company primers and financial metadata
* Prebuilt public company model XLSXs
* A web platform for AI-automated financial data analysis, modelling, and report-writing
* An Excel add-in to update any analyst model in seconds, and build any custom model in minutes
* MCP and APIs to expose our fundamental data to programmatic and agentic users

And we already have a long list of items in development with institutional partners, including macro data, supply chains, newsflow, privates and more.

\---

There’s still so much more we’ve got planned, but we’re genuinely so excited to start giving every investor the tools they need to make intelligent decisions in the AI age. So thanks for reading, and **head to [https://finbar.com](https://finbar.com) to try us out**. We’re looking forward to your thoughts!

launches.title: finbar: your AI financial data analyst
launches.tagline: Eliminate manual data entry. Update financial models in seconds.
launches.body:
Hi! We’re Ed and Robin, the founders of [finbar](https://finbar.com/).

**Our summary**: **too many analysts across finance still rely on manually collecting and compiling data for their models - we’re here to completely automate that process.** 

Several multi-billion AUM hedge funds already use us for exactly that - but if you work with financial data in any capacity, we want to help!

# finbar

1. Automatically extracts and compiles data from thousands of companies globally, public and private
2. Gives analysts tools to easily explore and reshape data for their own use cases
3. Provides powerful automation to update models with new data in seconds

**If you’ve ever spent hours copying data from a bunch of PDFs into a spreadsheet, you understand the core problem we solve!**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87042&key=user_uploads/2312013/e56da6c5-76fa-44d5-b30b-94aaedec850c)

**Why can we do this better than others?** Financial data is inherently very messy – we’ve spent more than a year building a highly bespoke pipeline geared for financial data: numeric algorithms, text processing, OCR, LLMs, and more. This means in minutes we can provide complete series data from any set of documents: PDFs, Excels, websites, scans, etc.

We also understand the financial domain intimately well – our starting point has always been to build something that would have saved us hours per day as hedge fund analysts.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87042&key=user_uploads/2312013/d80aa23d-1e53-448f-8f0b-f6c2b7d47171)

**Want to learn more?** [**Watch a full demo here!**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DGh_3TDVb4M)

**If you spend time working with financial data in any field, we believe we can save you valuable time.** We’re live with several multi-billion AUM hedge funds but are also very interested in speaking to anyone in banking, research, PE, VC, accounting, or corporate. We’d love to help you!

**Head to **[**https://finbar.com/about**](https://finbar.com/about)** to request a trial – or reach out directly to **[**ehuang@finbar.com**](mailto:ehuang@finbar.com)**!**

# About us

**Ed** was a hedge fund analyst at Balyasny, and before that was at Goldman Sachs. He solo-founded finbar up to first revenue and now leads product and commerce. He is a CFA charterholder.

**Robin** was a software engineer at Thought Machine, working on a globally deployed cloud-native banking platform. He now leads the finbar tech effort.

We’ve been close friends for 13 years, through school, then Oxford, then as roommates in London – and of course now as co-founders!

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87042&key=user_uploads/2312013/e2bf30db-5b91-4870-99c5-7725c2baee31)

 Thanks for reading - happy modeling!
